Assumption difference with STK-div-weakass-pushforward (chapter spans 719-754, lemma-weakass-pushforward): that card assumes only quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of f and states the weak association conclusion; this card asks additionally for flatness of F over S and, in the last three parts, for a finite pushforward and Noetherian local rings. Conclusion difference: its conclusion is part (1) of this statement, while parts (3) to (6) (depth at least two, nonzerodivisors under flatness, and the depth bound) are different conclusions not stated there; the overlap is recorded by means of this line and only the genuinely new parts are offered as the content of this card.
